notes:
Summary: RivetLine runs a distributed contact center platform for mid-large eCommerce merchants. Primary goals: reduce avg handle time (AHT) via agent assist, provide accurate ticket summaries for escalation, and enable deterministic tool-calls (CRM update, refund API) from assistant. They already maintain multiple knowledge sources (Zendesk KB, Confluence, product docs in S3, and a legacy SQL index.)

Key technical asks / constraints:
- RAG with citations: agents must present source links and confidence meta; compliance requires traceable provenance per snippet.
- Freshness window: some KBs updated hourly (ops runbooks), others weekly (policy); want incremental re-indexing and TTL policies per source.
- Multi-source retrieval: de-dup + source-priority rules (e.g., product docs > community forum).
- Tool-calling reliability: confirmations and idempotency required; want transactional guarantees when assistant triggers CRM update.
- Reliability under spikes: plan for seasonal eCom peaks (10-20x baseline). require fallbacks: model variant routing, cache-first responses, and graceful degrade to read-only retrieval when write paths congested.

Quote from CTO (call 2026-01-20): "If citations can't be audited we can't ship this to our enterprise accounts."

POC specifics: ingest pipeline built by RivetLine infra; Redwood team provided config for continuous indexing + hybrid retriever. POC metrics under review: precision@3 for KB retrieval, avg latency (cold vs warm), token cost per call.

Open items: legal needs specific residency clause for EU customers; security team requested sample audit logs for a 30-day retention preview. Pricing sensitivity moderate — willing to pay premium for deterministic uptime and certifiable audit trail.
